answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lotus of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the summit until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the haven of the next round. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
